v1.0.0-dataset-1.description: Balanced AI-focused dataset: 1,190 rows collected via Adzuna keyword search across 5 canonical TalentLens roles (AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Data Analyst). Each role queried separately; deduplicated by job_id; filtered to canonical roles only (no Other bucket). Schema matches tests/test_schema_contract.py.
